units.passage: Generative Artificial Intelligence (AI) Guide : This CTS guide provides information on the legal, ethical, and privacy considerations of using AI at Duquesne.
units.why: The CTS guide covers 'legal, ethical, and privacy considerations of using AI' and Copilot; points to privacy guidance and a vetted tool, P50.

units.passage: East Carolina University encourages exploration of these products or services, but individuals must remain cognizant of data being provided to these tools, as well as abide by copyright laws, compliance regulations, Employee Code of Conduct, and Student Code of Conduct.
units.why: Requires individuals to 'remain cognizant of data being provided to these tools'. This is a data-protection duty, so P50 and not P02. Final codes follow the resolution_why.

units.passage: Only generative AI products or services that are run offline and locally on ECU managed devices or are listed on the Sensitive Data Storage and Transmission website are authorized to process protected institutional data.
units.why: For protected data, only offline or local tools or tools on the Sensitive Data list are 'authorized'. It restricts use to vetted tools, so P50 (prefer vetted tools). P17 does not fit because no course tool is provided.

units.passage: Use of protected data with other generative AI products or services could violate state or federal statutes such as HIPAA and FERPA and/or University regulations.
units.why: Warns that other tools 'could violate state or federal statutes such as HIPAA and FERPA'. This is the rationale for data protection, P50.

units.passage: Each generative AI product or service listed on the website will clarify its compatibility with various data levels.
units.why: Listed tools 'will clarify its compatibility with various data levels'. Describes how approved tools are documented for users, part of vetted-tool guidance, P50.

units.passage: Passphrases must never be used with generative AI products or services that are not integrated with ECU’s single sign-on service.
units.why: 'Passphrases must never be used' with tools not on single sign-on. A prohibition that protects credentials, so P50.

units.passage: Never share any sensitive, personal, or institutional data other than what is outlined on the Sensitive Storage and Transmission web site.
units.why: 'Never share any sensitive, personal, or institutional data' with tools considered public facing. Data protection, P50.

units.passage: Review and be familiar with ECU’s data classification standards: https://datagovernance.ecu.edu/ecu-data-classification/
units.why: Tells users to 'Review and be familiar with ECU’s data classification standards'. A practice recommendation for data protection, P50.

units.passage: Faculty, staff, and students who work with institutional data must be aware of HIPAA, FERPA, GDPR, GLBA, and other federal, state, or university regulations.
units.why: People working with institutional data 'must be aware of HIPAA, FERPA, GDPR, GLBA'. A legal-awareness duty tied to data privacy, P50.

units.passage: Available and approved software at the University can be found via the Licensed ECU Software Downloads, Apps, and Services website.
units.why: 'Available and approved software ... can be found' on the licensed software site. It points users to licensed tools, so P50 (prefer vetted or licensed tools). P17 does not fit because no specific tool is named.

units.passage: AI tools may require access to student data, which raises privacy concerns.
units.why: 'AI tools may require access to student data, which raises privacy concerns'. A privacy concern, P50.

units.passage: Shall not input Confidential Data or Regulated Data into or use GAI in a manner that would inappropriately disclose Confidential Data or Regulated Data to an unauthorized party;
units.why: 2.2 'Shall not input Confidential Data or Regulated Data' is a data-protection rule: P50.

units.passage: Shall immediately report a ny Breach or suspected Breach of data to the ETSU Office of Information Technology Services.
units.why: Users 'Shall immediately report' any breach or suspected breach of data to IT Services, a data-protection duty under P50.
